def re_arrange_array(arr, n):
    if n <= 0:
        return arr
    # We only consider the first n elements
    segment = arr[:n]
    negatives = [x for x in segment if x < 0]
    positives = [x for x in segment if x >= 0]
    # Replace the first n elements with rearranged order
    arr[:n] = negatives + positives
    return arr
